## 1. Objective

docs: bound llm-ledger archiving to sanitized audit records

MUST: archive review runs as audit records only — exclude logs/, agent-output/,
and snapshot/, which carry raw model output that the benchmark security
boundary forbids committing, or a nested worktree — and archive the matching
.review-benchmark/gold/<run-id>/ so report and rescore still recompute from the
archive.
MUST: stage and push from a dedicated ledger worktree after fetching
origin/llm-ledger, creating the branch from an orphan root only when absent;
on non-fast-forward rejection rebase onto the fetched tip and retry; remove
the delivery worktree only once the pushed tip contains the topic.
MUST NOT: commit raw reviewer logs or agent output to any branch, or drop the
gold tree from the archive.

Addresses the first two review rounds: raw-log security conflict, missing
gold, missing append protocol, git-ignored staging, and the omitted
ledger-checkout step.

## 4. Review focus

- Correctness of the changed behavior, including error, cancellation, timeout, and
  partial-failure paths.
- Concurrency, ordering, visibility, and lifecycle invariants when the diff touches them.
- API and documented-contract drift caused by the change.
- Missing tests only when the missing test protects a concrete failure mode introduced
  or revealed by the diff.

Do not report style-only nits, pre-existing defects outside the diff, or speculative
concerns without a concrete trigger and observable consequence.
